sections.section: Guide Bund of the Proposed Bridge
strengths: Provides specific alignment angles for the guide bunds.
Offers detailed tabular data for proposed service roads (width, location, length).
weaknesses: Combines two completely unrelated topics (guide bunds and service roads) within a single section, leading to very poor organization.
Lacks explicit justification or detailed design reasoning for the specific guide bund angles.
issues: Poor logical flow and organization due to merging disparate content.
sections.reason: This section is poorly organized, abruptly combining detailed information on guide bunds with entirely separate details on service roads, significantly hindering clarity and consistency, despite the individual technical merits of each sub-topic.

issues: The content does not fully cover the scope implied by the section title (missing culvert details).
sections.reason: The section provides clear and consistent details for major bridges but falls short by not detailing the drainage study findings and omitting information on culverts, despite its title.
